chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: O Thabit! When Allah loves a servant, He pours afflictions upon him heavily and rains them down upon him heavily. And we, along with you, will pass our mornings and evenings with him (unaware of his suffering).
ai.seo_question: What is the sign that Allah loves a servant according to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) elucidates the concept of *ghuth* (intense, overwhelming affliction) as a sign of divine love, drawing on the linguistic nuance of being 'thrust' into trials. This hadith highlights the communal solidarity of the Ahl al-Bayt, who share in the believer's suffering, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Imam's role as a compassionate intercessor and companion in hardship. The severity of the test is not a punishment but a purification, aligning with the Shia understanding of *bala'* as a means of elevating spiritual rank.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 40. It has been narrated that Abu Hamzah said that

Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said: O Thabit! When Allah loves a person, He pours afflictions on him and rains them heavily on him. And (all the while) we pass our days and nights with him (unaware of his suffering).
